blocks.text: 20 questions: ten from each of the 2 chapters, in a random order.

Your first answer to each question is the one that counts. 85% or better passes, and passing earns the badge for Conjugation, Position Verbs and -ся. You can take it as often as you like; the questions are dealt afresh each time.
